Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 16.5 - JoJo Part 4 Update
Story Mode Meta Unit
This unit is one of the most effective units in the game for Story Mode!

Overview

Crusader (Admin) is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Crusader.

Evolving

Crusader (Admin) can be evolved from Crusader with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Crusader
x12 Ice Crystallite
x12 Dark Crystallite
x6 Blood Crystallite
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)

Crusader (Admin)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7,500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
